snippet.title: The Tragedy at Deer Creek Trailer
snippet.description:
Photographer Charlotte Gray travels to Deer Creek to document a long deserted logging camp for her upcoming book ”Forgotten Frontiers”. She finds not only a derelict camp, but also a mournful tale of family, love and loyalty hidden beneath the Alaskan snow, in this point-and-click adventure. 

Interested? Visit:
www.sparrowland.studio
